Below is a **ready‑to‑go guide** you can copy into your planner or print out as a PDF. Feel free to tweak it—just replace the placeholders (dates, flight numbers, hotel names) with what works best for you! --- ## ✈️ Quick Snapshot | Item | Detail | |------|--------| | **Trip Length** | 5 days + 1 night (ideal balance between sightseeing and rest) | | **Best Time to Go** | Late March–May or September–October (mild weather, fewer crowds than July/August) | | **Budget Range** | €800–€1500 per person (mid‑range hotels, mix of paid & free sights) | > *Tip:* Book flights at least 3 months ahead for the lowest fares. Use fare alerts on Skyscanner or Google Flights. --- ## 📅 Sample Itinerary (Paris Only) ### Day 1 – Arrive & Get Settled | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | Morning | Flight lands → take RER B from Charles de Gaulle Airport to Gare du Nord (≈35 min). Check into hotel. | | Noon | Lunch near your hotel (try a crêperie for classic French comfort food). | | Afternoon | Stroll along the Seine, cross Pont Neuf, visit Shakespeare & Company bookshop. | | Evening | Dinner at Le Coupe Chou (romantic ambience, traditional cuisine). End night with a sunset cruise on the Seine (optional). | #### Suggested Hotels (by price) | Hotel | Price/night (€) | Notes | |-------|-----------------|-------| | Hôtel La Belle Juliette (budget) | ~90 | Charming boutique, close to Notre-Dame. | | Mercure Paris Centre Tour Eiffel | ~140 | Modern rooms, great location. | | Sofitel Saint Germain | ~260 | Luxury, spa access. | --- ### Day 2 – Classic Landmarks | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | 08:00 | Breakfast at Café Marly (inside Louvre). | | 09:30 | Visit Louvre Museum (buy skip‑the‑line tickets online). | | 13:00 | Picnic lunch in Jardin des Tuileries (grab baguette, cheese, wine). | | 14:30 | Walk to Palais Royal → stroll through its gardens. | | 16:00 | Head to Arc de Triomphe; climb to top for panoramic view. | | 18:00 | Explore Champs‑Élysées shops. | | 20:00 | Dinner at L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon (Michelin star, prix fixe menu). | *Optional*: If time allows, stop by Musée d’Orsay en route back. --- ### Day 3 – Montmartre & Artistic Vibes | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | 07:45 | Take Metro Line 12 to Abbesses. | | 08:15 | Coffee at Le Consulat café. | | 09:00 | Climb Sacré-Cœur Basilica; enjoy sweeping views. | | 11:00 | Wander Place du Tertre (artists selling paintings). | | 13:00 | Lunch at La Maison Rose (iconic spot). | | 15:00 | Visit Espace Dalí or Musée de la Vie Romantique. | | 17:30 | Return via metro to central station. | | 19:30 | Dinner at Septime (modern French tasting menu). | --- ### Day 4 – A Touch of Culture & Relaxation | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | 09:00 | Early morning walk in Luxembourg Gardens. | | 10:30 | Visit Panthéon (free entry). | | 12:30 | Brunch at Angelina’s (famous hot chocolate). | | 14:00 | Free afternoon: choose one — either explore Latin Quarter cafés or shop at Galeries Lafayette. | | 18:00 | Attend a classical concert at Théâtre des Champs‑Elysées (check schedules). | | 21:00 | Light dinner at Chez Gladines (Basque tapas). | --- ### Day 5 – Day Trip Option (Versailles or Giverny) Choose based on interest: | Destination | Highlights | Travel Time | |-------------|------------|--------------| | **Palace of Versailles** | Hall of Mirrors, Gardens, Grand Trianon | 40 min by train (RER C) | | **Giverny** | Monet’s House & Garden | 75 min by train (Mérigny line) | Return to Paris for last evening: - Sunset walk over Pont Alexandre III. - Farewell dinner at Le Jules Verne (restaurant inside Eiffel Tower). --- ### Departure Day | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | 08:00 | Pack & check-out. | | 09:00 | Grab breakfast at local boulangerie. | | 10:00 | Last-minute souvenir shopping (Rue Cler market). | | 12:00 | Transfer to airport via RER B or taxi. | --- ## 🌍 Optional Outskirts Excursions (if you have extra days) | Location | What to Do | How Long | |-----------|------------|---------| | **Champagne Region** | Reims Cathedral, champagne house tours (Veuve Clicquot, Moët & Chandon). | Full day | | **Normandy D-Day Beaches** | Omaha Beach, Caen Memorial. | Full day | | **Lyon** | Gastronomy tour, old town walking. | Overnight stay | Use regional trains (TGV) or guided bus tours. --- ## 🛠️ Practical Essentials | Category | Recommendation | |----------|---------------| | **Currency** | Euro (€); use contactless debit card where possible. | | **SIM Card/WiFi** | Buy a prepaid data pack at the airport (~€25 for 50GB). Or rent pocket WiFi. | | **Transportation Passes** | - **Navigo Week pass** (valid Monday–Sunday): unlimited metro/bus/RER within zones 1‑2.
- For short stays, consider buying individual ticket “carnet” (paper booklet of 10 single rides). | | **Safety** | Keep valuables secure; beware pickpockets around major tourist spots. | | **Health** | Bring basic medications; most pharmacies stock common ailments. | | **Language** | Basic phrases help: Bonjour! Merci! Où est…? | | **Weather Gear** | Layered clothing, umbrella, comfortable shoes. | --- ## 🎒 Packing Checklist | Item | Why | |------|-----| | Comfortable walking shoes | City streets often uneven. | | Lightweight rain jacket | Sudden showers common. | | Power adapter (Type C/F) | European sockets. | | Small backpack/day bag | Carry water bottle, map, camera. | | Copies of passport & reservations | In case originals lost. | | Portable charger | Keeps phone alive during long walks. | | Snacks (nuts, granola bars) | Handy when waiting in lines. | --- ## 💰 Rough Cost Breakdown (Mid‑Range Traveler) | Expense | Approximate Cost (€) | |---------|--------------------| | Roundtrip airfare (from US/EU) | 300–600 | | Hotel (average 120/night × 4 nights) | 480 | | Navigo week pass | 22 | | Meals (breakfast+lunch+dinner avg 60/d) | 240 | | Attractions (skip‑lines, museums) | 80 | | Souvenirs & extras | 100 | | Total | **~1522** | Adjust upward/downward depending on luxury choices or frugal habits. --- ## 🍽️ Culinary Hotspots | Dish | Where | |------|-------| | Croissants & Pain au Chocolat | Local bakery (Le Pain Quotidien) | | Coq au Vin | Restaurant Le Relais de l'Entrecôte | | Escargot | L’Auberge du Père Fumier | | Macarons | Ladurée or Pierre Hermé | | Cheese Board | Fromagerie Barthélémy | | Street Food (falafel, crepes)** | Rue Mouffetard | *(Street falafel in Marseille style is famous in Paris too.)* --- ## 🚨 Final Reminders 1. **Check visa requirements** before booking flights. EU citizens don’t need visas; others may require Schengen visa. 2. **Travel insurance** covering medical emergencies and cancellations is highly advisable. 3. **Keep digital copies** of all bookings emailed to yourself. 4. **Respect local customs:** dress modestly when visiting churches; remove hats indoors. Enjoy your adventure in the City of Lights! Let me know if you'd like more detail on any section (hotel links, restaurant reservations, or alternative itineraries). Bon voyage!
